research_rationale:
EO 12285 (President's Commission on Hostage Compensation), signed 1981-01-19. The order establishes the President's Commission on Hostage Compensation (Section 1-101), sets its study and report functions (1-201 to 1-204), its procedures and support (1-301 to 1-304) and general provisions (1-401, 1-402). Section 1-402 provides that the Commission shall terminate thirty days after submitting its report, which is report-relative and not a dated end. EO 12307 and EO 12317 later moved the report date, and EO 12294 Section 8 ratified this order. First end: Section 21 of EO 12379 (signed 1982-08-17, Termination of Boards, Committees, and Commissions) names this order by number, "Executive Order No. 12285," and provides that it is revoked. EO 12379 has no effective-date clause, so the revocation took effect on signing, 1982-08-17.  Machine searches adopted after reading their coverage notes: the U.S. Code search (release point 119-121, 0 hits for this order), the eCFR search as of 2026-10-14 (0 hits) and the Federal Register executive-order catalog disposition-note search (6 hits). They are leads only; the end, the later events and the savings were decided from the held Federal Register texts named in this claim. Search of the held order texts for this order's number (the packet records a bounded number-citation search over its lookup corpus, excluding clause-draft copies): apart from the order's own copies, the matching files are EO 11022, EO 11256, EO 11829, EO 12307, EO 12317, EO 12379. The files filed under EO 11022, EO 11256 and EO 11829 matched only because they carry the same Federal Register pages as the EO 12379 revocation list; they are not separate instruments naming this order.
